title: Blue Dinosaur Cacao Mint Bar - Box of 12 $11.99 (70% off - $1 Per Bar) + $9.99 Delivery (Free with $120 Order) @ Blue Dinosaur
body:
Deal: Blue Dinosaur Cacao Mint Bar - Box of 12 $11.99 (70% off - $1 Per Bar) + $9.99 Delivery (Free with $120 Order) @ Blue Dinosaur

[King Steuart] Any local pickup where?
Shipping kinda kills it
[mcgrathkerr] Yeah I love these. I bought 36 of them. And I also got 2 boxes of the protein ones. It’s the ingredients that do it for me. It generally costs more to get these foods with fewer and more natural ingredients. Big fan
[Lizard Spock] I've heard they don't actually contain any blue dinosaurs /s
[benjamin] "When co-founder Mike Watts-Seale was 14 years old, he made a pact with his best friend that if they ever started a business together in the future, they would name it "Blue Dinosaur". Years later, when Mike began hand-baking whole-food health bars out of his spare room and selling them at local CrossFit gyms, he stayed true to that childhood promise and officially launched the brand under that name."
[harvestloon] Thanks for putting the /s at the end that would have been confusing
[chyawala] The nutritional information appears to have errors, as Sat fat exceeds Total fat.
[Savealopoulos] Website error, label on packet shows 12.4g fat/bar with 11.7g sat fat.
[BatmanAU] Holy cow, 20grams of saturated fats (more than your daily average) and 15 grams of sugar in a tiny bar like that, is INSANELY high. No wonder we are becoming a fat unhealthy country
[Chocobros] What's more intriguing is the total fat per bar is less than the saturated fat…
Me thinks someone wrote the numbers down in the wrong order 😂
[Senthen] Got a shiver down my spine I read the name Blue Dinosaur, those free samples from 4 years ago tasted awful
[Savealopoulos] Not my flava of choice, but damn this range is awesome. Full of good fats and minimally processed.
